dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: You mean the Pneumousia Ray Self-Defense Device?

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: Well, when I offered to return it to Miss Fusilier, she immediately wanted to chuck it into the sea.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: It took some persuading, but she reluctantly agreed to let me use it for the time being. Though she also reiterated that she never wanted to lay eyes on it ever again.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: ...In any case, I'm very grateful for Miss Fusilier's kindness.
